excerpts.note: Opening: groove with a pickup hit before every other beat, break at ~1:35, drop at 1:40. Used while developing the engine and for the live in-app tests.

15:00-17:00. First evaluation failed the AMLt gate (off-beat locking in a kick-less section); inspected, which led to the general off-beat phase-inertia rule. First-run numbers are kept in the report.
30:00-32:00, held out for design v1; used in the design-v2 tuning sweep.
45:00-47:00, held out for design v1; used in the design-v2 tuning sweep.

7:30-9:30. Final-set excerpt of design v1: failed the F/AMLt gates (rolling-bass section where the phase slipped a sixteenth early). Afterwards used for development, so it no longer counts as held-out. First-run numbers are kept in the report.
37:30-39:30. Final-set excerpt of design v1 (passed with F=1.0). Used in the tuning sweep afterwards, so it no longer counts as held-out.
3:00-5:00, final set of design v2 (DSP only: failed on 3:00 and 21:00). Used to develop the hybrid arbiter, so no longer held-out.
